letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every cool breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laughter lights up my days, and your smile steadies my nights, no matter which time zone we’re in. As the calendar flips to another golden season, I fall deeper in love with my cutie, my partner, my forever. Thank you for being my home wherever we are—my heart beats only for you.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s gleam,  
Your love is the thread in my sweetest dream.  
With you, each day feels brand new,  
My heart, my jaan, forever with you.
